entries.reason: Cannot build libsoup from the 2016-era analysis worktree. The autogen.sh script requires intltoolize (package: intltool) which is not installed and cannot be installed without sudo. Additionally, the configure-generated header soup-version.h is needed for compilation of test harnesses but requires running autogen.sh/autoreconf first. The native test (/auth/authorization-header-request in tests/auth-test.c) also requires Apache HTTP server with Digest auth module configured on port 47524.
missing_dependencies: libsoup-2.4 development headers (pkg-config libsoup-2.4 not found)
Apache HTTP server with mod_auth_digest on port 47524 (for native test)
entries.recommendation: Install intltool and libsoup2.4-dev packages to enable building and testing. Alternatively, use the meson-based build from the repo's main branch (which doesn't need intltool) after backporting the patch.
